body_lead: BENGALURU, INDIA – July 24, 2026 — The ISACA Bangalore Chapter officially inaugurated the 29th edition of its Annual Karnataka Conference today at the Taj MG Road, Bengaluru. Centered on the timely theme “Fortify the AI Backbone and Agentic AI – Govern, Secure, and Thrive,” the power-packed, two-day event runs through July 25, 2026. Record-Breaking Industry Engagement Building on the success of its 2025 conference—which drew 300 delegates—this year’s event has set a new benchmark as the largest in ISACA Bangalore’s history, boasting over 400 registered attendees.
